53: class Client:
54:     """The Client class is the main entrypoint to execute GraphQL requests
55:     on a GQL transport.
56: 
57:     It can take sync or async transports as argument and can either execute
58:     and subscribe to requests itself with the
59:     :func:`execute <gql.client.Client.execute>` and
60:     :func:`subscribe <gql.client.Client.subscribe>` methods
61:     OR can be used to get a sync or async session depending on the
62:     transport type.
63: 
64:     To connect to an :ref:`async transport <async_transports>` and get an
65:     :class:`async session <gql.client.AsyncClientSession>`,
66:     use :code:`async with client as session:`
67: 
68:     To connect to a :ref:`sync transport <sync_transports>` and get a
69:     :class:`sync session <gql.client.SyncClientSession>`,
70:     use :code:`with client as session:`
71:     """
72: 
73:     def __init__(
74:         self,
75:         *,
76:         schema: Optional[Union[str, GraphQLSchema]] = None,
77:         introspection: Optional[IntrospectionQuery] = None,
78:         transport: Optional[Union[Transport, AsyncTransport]] = None,
79:         fetch_schema_from_transport: bool = False,
80:         introspection_args: Optional[Dict] = None,
81:         execute_timeout: Optional[Union[int, float]] = 10,
82:         serialize_variables: bool = False,
83:         parse_results: bool = False,
84:         batch_interval: float = 0,
85:         batch_max: int = 10,
86:     ):
87:         """Initialize the client with the given parameters.
88: 
89:         :param schema: an optional GraphQL Schema for local validation
90:                 See :ref:`schema_validation`
91:         :param transport: The provided :ref:`transport <Transports>`.
92:         :param fetch_schema_from_transport: Boolean to indicate that if we want to fetch
93:                 the schema from the transport using an introspection query.
94:         :param introspection_args: arguments passed to the
95:                 :meth:`gql.utilities.get_introspection_query_ast` method.
96:         :param execute_timeout: The maximum time in seconds for the execution of a
97:                 request before a TimeoutError is raised. Only used for async transports.
98:                 Passing None results in waiting forever for a response.
99:         :param serialize_variables: whether the variable values should be
100:             serialized. Used for custom scalars and/or enums. Default: False.
101:         :param parse_results: Whether gql will try to parse the serialized output
102:                 sent by the backend. Can be used to deserialize custom scalars or enums.
103:         :param batch_interval: Time to wait in seconds for batching requests together.
104:                 Batching is disabled (by default) if 0.
105:         :param batch_max: Maximum number of requests in a single batch.
106:         """
107: 
108:         if introspection:
109:             assert (
110:                 not schema
111:             ), "Cannot provide introspection and schema at the same time."
112:             schema = build_client_schema(introspection)
113: 
114:         if isinstance(schema, str):
115:             type_def_ast = parse(schema)
116:             schema = build_ast_schema(type_def_ast)
117: 
118:         if transport and fetch_schema_from_transport:
119:             assert (
120:                 not schema
121:             ), "Cannot fetch the schema from transport if is already provided."
122: 
123:             assert not type(transport).__name__ == "AppSyncWebsocketsTransport", (
124:                 "fetch_schema_from_transport=True is not allowed "
125:                 "for AppSyncWebsocketsTransport "
126:                 "because only subscriptions are allowed on the realtime endpoint."
127:             )
128: 
129:         if schema and not transport:
130:             transport = LocalSchemaTransport(schema)
131: 
132:         # GraphQL schema
133:         self.schema: Optional[GraphQLSchema] = schema
134: 
135:         # Answer of the introspection query
136:         self.introspection: Optional[IntrospectionQuery] = introspection
137: 
138:         # GraphQL transport chosen
139:         assert (
140:             transport is not None
141:         ), "You need to provide either a transport or a schema to the Client."
142:         self.transport: Union[Transport, AsyncTransport] = transport
143: 
144:         # Flag to indicate that we need to fetch the schema from the transport
145:         # On async transports, we fetch the schema before executing the first query
146:         self.fetch_schema_from_transport: bool = fetch_schema_from_transport
147:         self.introspection_args = (
148:             {} if introspection_args is None else introspection_args
149:         )
150: 
151:         # Enforced timeout of the execute function (only for async transports)
152:         self.execute_timeout = execute_timeout
153: 
154:         self.serialize_variables = serialize_variables
155:         self.parse_results = parse_results
156:         self.batch_interval = batch_interval
157:         self.batch_max = batch_max
